_comment: Machine-readable distillation of gateway-recipe.md / subvi-placement.md / SKILL.md verified facts. Every entry carries 'src' = the recipe section that verified it. Terminal entries: idx = Terms[] index (primitives OUTPUT-FIRST) or wire-kind for loop/SR terminals. Update this file TOGETHER with the prose docs.

wire_kinds.c|0: control/constant/indicator own terminal (arg1 side = its label)
wire_kinds.n|<i>: index into a NODE's Terms[] (primitives output-first: [0]=out)
wire_kinds.i|0: loop COUNTER terminal (arg1's source label = the LOOP's label, e.g. wire 'Loop1|Add1' 'i|0|n|2')
wire_kinds.st%d: WhileLoop STOP terminal (st1 = stop-if-TRUE, the common case; st0 = continue-if-true; accepts boolean or error cluster; trailing |0 ignored)
wire_kinds.sli<i>|0: shift register left INSIDE (previous-iteration value) - SOURCE
wire_kinds.sri<i>|0: shift register right INSIDE (per-iteration) - INOUT sink
wire_kinds.sro<i>|0: shift register right OUTSIDE (final value) - SOURCE
wire_kinds.s|2: Select selector input (bool/comparison output goes HERE, never to f|1)
wire_kinds.t|3: Select TRUE input (t and f MUST be the same type)

1114.name: Greater Or Equal To 0?

terms.0: out (always TRUE for i>=0 - scripted TRUE source)

1114.src: v3.28; x input index not recorded - check wires Name

1903.name: Add Array Elements
1903.note: NEEDS BOUNDS - place with H=40 gives 1 chunk

2049.name: Bundle
2049.note: growable: placed height ~= 8.7 px per element (H=66->8, H=40->5); getNode may list garbage terminals beyond real count; errors verb 'type of the sink is cluster of N elements' is ground truth; avoid resized Bundles

2005.name: Numeric Constant (BD)
2005.note: placed instance is I32; change representation via setval arg3 (see representation_codes)

21703.name: Waveform Graph (modern, FP)
21703.note: FP object - place arg2 MUST be 'x,y,W,H' (e.g. 400,300)

2070.name: Array Constant shell (BD)
2070.note: place elements INSIDE via resolver: place <vi>|BD%GObject|<shellLabel>

2071.name: Cluster Constant shell (BD)
2071.note: place elements INSIDE via resolver: place <vi>|BD%GObject|<shellLabel>; verified clusterX={Num1} end-to-end

21607.name: Cluster control (FP)
21607.note: elements via place <vi>|FP%GObject|<clusterLabel>; works inside loops too (shell via |BD%GObject|<loopLabel>)

21003.name: Numeric Control (FP)
21003.note: FP object - needs W,H in arg2

21004.name: Numeric Indicator (FP)
21004.note: FP object - needs W,H in arg2

2353.name: Feedback Node
2353.note: MAP IS RANDOM PER INSTANCE (both creation paths seen) - wire, then read isSource flags in wires; delete the wire by the UID SHOWN IN WIRES and rewire if wrong

23504.name: Pi (special constant)
23504.note: places a REAL FixedConstant with value pi

23505.name: Pi Multiplied By 2 (special constant)
23505.note: TRAP: silently places a plain value-0 Numeric Constant! For 2pi place 23504 and Multiply by 2

terms.0: N (in, SINK - as a source it raises 1055); wire 'NConst|Loop' 'c|0|n|0'

ForLoop.note: counter = kind i|0, NOT in Terms[] (Terms[1] is NULL); border tunnels are auto-created Auto-Index - switch array crossings to Regular with loop;<vi>%ForLoop|L;tunnel:<idx>;0

WhileLoop.note: counter i|0; stop terminal st%d (st1 common); error cluster wires to st1 too

Select.note: t and f MUST be same type; bool goes to s|2 NEVER f|1

cells.0: error out (I32 error CODE, not a cluster)
cells.10: intervals in (scalar I32 bin count, NOT a cluster; default 10, bins span min..max)

Std Deviation and Variance.vi.note: one call gives mean AND sigma; prefer over Mean.vi (pane probe empty)

cells.15: error out (I32 code - wire to Error Cluster From Error Code)

Linear Fit.vi.note: cells 1,2,3,10,13 = not linked; (LS) instance lacks tolerance/method/bounds (its 9-13 empty); probe the PLACED node %Node|<label> - Terms[] is ground truth

verified: GObject (any object - used as nesting target)
resolver_classes.syntax: <path.vi>[|BD|FP|Other]%<Class>|<Label>[<%Class|Label>...]; |BD default; wrong class = ERROR 1092 (Traverse Initialization Failed)

error_codes.1055: To More Specific Class - resolver FOUND the object but a cast failed (wrong kind, or the verb's branch does not accept this class)
error_codes.1092: Traverse Initialization Failed - wrong resolver CLASS name
error_codes.1093: delete failed for that UID - use the UID from the wires verb output
error_codes.1061: New VI Object cannot place this (e.g. Error Ring Constant - dialog-configured node)
error_codes.74: Flattened String To Variant - type string / data mismatch in setval XML

batch_format.meta: delete;<path> (2-field = FILE delete), copy;<src>;<dst>, echo;<text>, sleep;<ms>
batch_format.trap: a 6th field on place is silently ignored -> unlabeled object -> ERROR 1092 later
